intro.description: I engineer performant, secure, and modern web applications with focus on zero-knowledge encryption, clean interfaces, and resilient backend systems.

websiteSection.designedBy: Built as part of the Elixpo Portfolios platform — connecting verified contributions, open projects, and personal research across the community.
websiteSection.futurePlans: Deepening work in zero-knowledge cryptography, secure web runtimes, and privacy-preserving machine learning on the client. Continuing active contributions across the Elixpo open-source ecosystem.
websiteSection.codeStory: From building zero-knowledge architectures in Vault-me to detecting synthesized video streams in real-time with Stober, my engineering mindset centers around verifiable security and practical utility. Building in public with Elixpo has reinforced the value of open source, code hygiene, and collaborative craftsmanship.
